\begin{document}
The lattice sum is expressed through $\zeta(s)$, the Epstein zeta function of the square lattice,
$\zeta(s) = \sum_{(m,n)\neq(0,0)} (m^2+n^2)^{-s}$. Its value relevant here is
\begin{equation}
\zeta(2) = \frac{2\pi^2}{3}\,\mathrm{G}_{c} ,
\label{eq:e2}
\end{equation}
where $\mathrm{G}_c$ is Catalan's constant.
\end{document}
